title: Superpowers: Zenith Protocol
description: A massive endgame expansion that lets you trade Ancient Tokens to unlock, equip, and master unique superpowers across 25 Gem paths.
body:
> ⚠️ **In active development.** New abilities and systems land regularly — expect the occasional rough edge or quirky ability interaction. Bug reports are hugely appreciated!

## 🌟 Overview
Ever felt like vanilla's endgame runs out of things to chase? **Zenith Protocol** turns boss-farming into an economy and superpowers into a deeply customizable class system. Mix and match **25 Gem paths** and **90+ abilities** to build the ultimate superhero — call down Orbital Strikes, bend Gravity, wield Ancient Runic magic, or assimilate the DNA of the world's creatures.

## 🧭 New — The Path to Zenith Questline
Not sure where to start? A built-in **35-quest, 7-chapter questline** (open the **🎯 Quests** screen from your loadout) walks you through the whole mod — from your first Ancient Token and Power Gem all the way to Zenith mastery. No wiki required.

## 💎 Getting Started
Powers are **earned**, not dug up:
- **Ancient Tokens** are the master currency — from the Warden, Wither, Ender Dragon, and the mod's own Champions.
- **Blank Power Gems** unlock your potential to absorb powers — found in Ancient Cities / End Cities, or bought.
- **The Gem Trader:** place a Block of Amethyst by an unemployed Villager to hire a gem dealer.
- **The Gamble:** buy **Unidentified Geodes** to roll for a random Power Gem.
- **Zenith Forge & Infusion:** infuse gems, **socket** them into armor & weapons, and **awaken** netherite gear into unique artifacts.

## ⚔️ Champions & Elites
Hostile mobs can spawn as glowing, named, element-themed **Champions** — and rarer **Elites** that arrive with a matching retinue of bodyguards. They scale to your power, hit hard, and drop Ancient Tokens + loot. (And no, you can't cheese them from the air — they'll come to you.)

## 🏭 Build an Economy
A full progression of automated machines and structures: Slime, Gold, Iron, Blaze, Froglight, Shulker, Guardian & Bartering **farms**, the **Wither Slayer**, the **Quantum Quarry**, the **Experience Obelisk**, the **Sentinel Nexus** (keep an area mob-free), and the **Arena** — an Arena Core opens a powers-enabled PvP zone, with a survival-craftable **Arena Leaderboard**.

## ⚙️ Core Systems
- **25 Gem paths** — Fire, Lightning, Frost, Time, Ender, Gravity, Force (Jedi), Flora & more.
- **90 Active Abilities** across combat, utility, mobility and team support.
- **Custom UIs** — press **R** for the Loadout Manager: equip 10 actives, manage passives/cores, with a live cooldown/toggle HUD.
- **Mastery System** — using abilities earns points; hit 1,000 to **Master** a gem for permanent buffs + an ultimate.
- **Adaptive difficulty** — mobs scale to your unlocked power, with a cushion that keeps it fair for newcomers.

## 🚀 Spotlight Mechanics
- **Smart Dimension Hopping (Ender):** rift to the Nether (stand) or End (sneak) — finds a safe landing and remembers your base.
- **DNA Assimilation (Druid):** scan mobs (**H**) and shift into their aspect — Enderman teleport, Spider climb, Creeper detonation…
- **Deflection Stance (Jedi):** auto-deflect arrows, fireballs, and tridents back at attackers.

## 🤝 Multiplayer & Team Synergy
A built-in **Team Manager** — friendly-fire protection on AoE, team heals, Sanctuary Domes, and Guardian rescue-teleports.

## 👑 The Zenith Protocol
Collect and imprint all **25 Power Gems** to trigger the Zenith Protocol: a permanent **15% cooldown reduction** to every ability, permanent resistance buffs, and a cosmetic demigod aura.

## 📥 Dependencies
**Fabric API** (required) · Built for **Minecraft 1.21.1** (Fabric).

*Modpacks and servers are 100% free to use this mod!*
